run_eval_tasks_cli: run the VILBERT multi-task evaluation CLI with specified tasks and pretrained model checkpoint
evaluate_vilbert_model: evaluate a VILBert model on multiple vision-language tasks using validation dataloaders
load_eval_datasets: load evaluation datasets for specified multi-task IDs from the VILBERT task configuration
run_baseline_evaluation: run evaluation using the single-stream baseline BERT model instead of VILBert
save_eval_results_json: save evaluation results and auxiliary outputs as JSON files to the output directory
